result.summary: Found 2 layout/content issues: restaurant names and related text are truncated in the horizontal carousels, harming readability and scannability.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the third restaurant name is clipped mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol'), so the full title is unreadable even though the card itself is mostly on-screen.
issues.suggestion: Allow restaurant name text to wrap to dual lines, use a smaller type size, or ensure card width and truncation (ellipsis) leave enough of the name visible.

issues.description: The bottom popular card shows only the food image with a '-20%' badge and heart icon; restaurant name, rating, delivery time, and other metadata that appear on the card above are missing from the visible portion of this card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure each restaurant card consistently includes title and key metadata below or overlaid on the image, and that vertical spacing keeps at least the title visible when the card enters the viewport.
